scenarios.title: Initialize in a Windows path with spaces and accents
Re-run the initialization on the same project
Inspect the scene through the configured MCP
notes: 31 tools advertised by BlenderMCP; get_scene_info read without mutation; GUI session started and stopped by the test (port 9876)

scenarios.title: Build two simple articulated characters and one prop (240 frames at 24 fps)
notes: 41 objects, 2 armatures of 18 bones, cyclic slotted Actions, file reopened by scene.inspect

scenarios.title: Re-run the same operation after a lost response
notes: idempotent replay (same task_id, a single v001); different parameters -> SCENE_CONFLICT exit 3

scenarios.title: Interrupt the worker after an output is created but before commit
notes: worker killed after the outputs were written -> unknown state (exit 5); reconcile -> failed + partial effects; re-run with the same operation_id -> a single v002

scenarios.title: Manually modify a protected object between two operations
notes: hash mismatch -> SCENE_CONFLICT (exit 3), file preserved; `revision accept` -> revision 2; stale expected_revision=1 -> conflict

scenarios.title: Slow down an animation on a variant
notes: 48 -> 57.6 frames (x1.2), contact markers 1/25 -> 1/30, source v001 untouched (hash), 6 before/after frames

scenarios.title: Render then assemble the preview
notes: 240/240 Workbench PNG in 10.798 s, MP4 24/1 yuv420p, ffprobe nb_read_frames=240, 10 s duration, shot.validate technical_pass

scenarios.title: Export an animation as GLB
notes: Khronos 2.0.0-dev.3.10: 0 error, 0 warning(s); consistent Blender re-import

scenarios.title: Run without network after an approved preparation
notes: worker launched with --offline-mode (Blender network disabled), no provider enabled, scene produced without any download

scenarios.title: Supply an escaping path or a command as a parameter
notes: ../ paths, external absolute path and UNC -> PERMISSION_REQUIRED (exit 2); ';' in an enum -> VALIDATION_FAILED (exit 4); no file created

scenarios.title: Exhaust the budget or request an unavailable permission
notes: inspect profile -> PERMISSION_REQUIRED (exit 2); 240 frames > budget 24 -> BUDGET_EXCEEDED (exit 6); journal request_blocked

scenarios.title: Versioned skinned Rigify character: semantic mapping and five deformation poses
notes: Vitruvian CC0, 37,436 influenced vertices, complete Rigify mapping; five finite deformation responses and PNG views; source hash unchanged; incomplete mapping refused; artistic review pending

scenarios.title: Live: identity check and read-only inspection of the open scene
notes: identity (project, file, revision, runtime, clean) verified through bpy.ops.fluidblend.identity; scene.inspect ran in the GUI session; report published

scenarios.title: Live: isolated write (retime) publishes a new version and reloads the session
notes: retime executed in the open session; v002 saved as a copy, published, revision 2; session reloaded on v002; v001 hash unchanged

scenarios.title: Live: unsaved manual changes block the write and are preserved
notes: dirty session → SCENE_CONFLICT (exit 3), nothing published, manual change kept; scene.checkpoint snapshots the unsaved scene (copy=True)

scenarios.title: Live: wrong file open in the session is refused
notes: session opened on an unrelated unsaved scene → identity mismatch → SCENE_CONFLICT, no task executed in Blender

scenarios.title: Live: lost response leaves an unknown state that reconciliation resolves
notes: call timeout → task unknown (exit 5); retry refused until reconcile; reconcile → failed (result found, not committed); retry succeeds on the clean session

Live: edit before publication prevents publishing or reloading
